features.feature_summary: The SDK no longer includes the deprecated org.apache.http.legacy library in its AndroidManifest.xml, which can break apps that load the legacy map renderer; deprecated on 2026-01-31.
features.extended_definition: The SDK no longer includes the deprecated org.apache.http.legacy library in its AndroidManifest.xml, which can break apps that load the legacy map renderer; deprecated on 2026-01-31.

features.feature_summary: The Transit layer lets you display a city's public transit network on your map.
features.extended_definition: The Transit layer lets you display a city's public transit network on your map.

features.feature_summary: Data-driven styling for boundaries lets you access Google-provided administrative boundary polygons, style them, and display them on your maps.
features.extended_definition: Data-driven styling for boundaries lets you access Google-provided administrative boundary polygons, style them, and display them on your maps.

features.feature_summary: Data-driven styling for datasets lets you upload geospatial datasets, style their features, and display them on maps.
features.extended_definition: Data-driven styling for datasets lets you upload geospatial datasets, style their features, and display them on maps.

features.feature_summary: The SDK updated the default map colors to match the newer Google Maps app color palette.
features.extended_definition: The SDK updated the default map colors to match the newer Google Maps app color palette.

features.feature_summary: The MapsInitializer.Renderer.LEGACY option is deprecated in Maps SDK for Android v19.0.0 in favor of the latest map renderer; deprecated on 2024-06-25.
features.extended_definition: The MapsInitializer.Renderer.LEGACY option is deprecated in Maps SDK for Android v19.0.0 in favor of the latest map renderer; deprecated on 2024-06-25.

features.feature_summary: The map color scheme can be set to dark, light, or system settings.
features.extended_definition: The map color scheme can be set to dark, light, or system settings.

features.feature_summary: Cloud-based maps styling in Google Cloud Console lets you customize the appearance of maps used in Android applications.
features.extended_definition: Cloud-based maps styling in Google Cloud Console lets you customize the appearance of maps used in Android applications.

features.feature_summary: Advanced markers provide highly performant markers with customizable background, border, glyph color, and custom icon graphics.
features.extended_definition: Advanced markers provide highly performant markers with customizable background, border, glyph color, and custom icon graphics.

features.feature_summary: Polyline customization adds advanced controls for styling polylines.
features.extended_definition: Polyline customization adds advanced controls for styling polylines.
